novelty_flags.label: prop:latent-free-reduction
novelty_flags.one_line: The stated latent-free reduction is explicitly already established by AboueiEtAl2024LatentSID Remark 5.2 and should be retained only as a sanity/regression corollary, not a novel result.

soundness_flags.label: prop:ukb-selection-audit
soundness_flags.one_line: A graphwise sID failure certificate witnesses one constructed selected-law fiber, not the particular two-margin Tian input; the proposition supplies neither a fusion map from those margins to one P(V|S=1) nor a data-compatible fiber test, so its claimed countermodels need not agree with the audited data.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:executable-success-or-certificate
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Effective rational inverse-lift construction is assumed rather than proved in this conditional compilation theorem.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Total success-or-certificate compilation holds conditional on a constructor satisfying oeq:compositional-inverse-lift for every actual terminal failure.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 7-8, Theorem 5.1, Algorithm 1, Remark 5.3; p. 18, Eq. 23
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives a sufficient condition and sound Algorithm 1, and Remark 5.3 explicitly conjectures completeness when FAIL occurs.
For the fully observed augmented-DAG S-ID problem, the paper states Algorithm 1 is sound and complete.
Ordinary semi-Markovian hedges yield binary countermodels, and the ordinary ID algorithm is complete.
The c-gID result explicitly incorporates positivity and states that its completeness models satisfy that assumption.
Conditioning/intervention behavior is controlled away from selection ancestors, while the ancestor restriction cannot generally be relaxed.

source_verification_receipts.version: Nature Human Behaviour 7, version of record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Selective UK Biobank participation can induce instrument-confounder association and violate an MR exchangeability assumption.
The imaging subsample displays healthy-selection differences from the wider UK Biobank cohort.
Participation in optional UK Biobank components has genetic predictors and can bias genetic and phenotypic associations.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace prop:ukb-selection-audit's graphwise certificate conclusion with a precisely defined observed-margin-to-full-law fusion operator and a data-compatible response-type/fiber feasibility test; otherwise state only the audit's necessary conditions.
Demote prop:latent-free-reduction to an explicitly non-novel regression/sanity corollary, leaving the selected-law inverse-lift and graphwise iff as the only scientific headline claims.

After the two-virtual-edge calculation, state and prove the maximal incidence subclass on which the lift works, with an inclusion relation to AboueiEtAl2024LatentSID's published class; this gives a publishable fallback if universal lifting fails.

recommended_next_step: Revise the UK Biobank proposition into a data-compatible audit and demote the published latent-free reduction; then advance the graphwise inverse-lift kernel to Stage 0.
